snippet.title: Feed the Scorchpot Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
This is Feed the Scorchpot. It’s weird, it’s funny, it’s addictive - and yes, it’s a roguelite. Be the first to see it.

Care for a taste? Wishlist us on Steam to reserve your seat at the table: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966510/Feed_the_Scorchpot/
